original_ai_output.title_zh: 托里特：洛邦警告SPLM党内参选人勿提前竞选
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 东赤道州看守州长路易斯·洛邦·洛乔雷警告执政党SPLM内寻求政治职位的参选人，不得在党内初选前提前竞选、煽动部族情绪或携带重武装保镖。洛邦还否认有关他将参加即将举行选举的猜测，称现阶段未领取提名表。他要求参选人尊重提名程序，并指示各县专员制止未经批准的社区竞选集会。

location.raw_text: SPLM state secretariat in Torit, Eastern Equatoria

key_facts.fact: 东赤道州看守州长洛邦警告SPLM参选人不得提前竞选、煽动部族情绪或使用重武装保镖
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Eastern Equatoria caretaker governor Louis Lobong Lojore has warned aspirants seeking political positions under the ruling SPLM against premature campaigning, tribal incitement and the use of heavily armed bodyguards

key_facts.fact: 洛邦否认有关他将参加即将举行选举的猜测，称现阶段未领取提名表
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Lobong also dismissed speculation about his participation in the forthcoming elections, saying he was not collecting a nomination form at this stage.

key_facts.fact: 洛邦在托里特SPLM州秘书处发表上述讲话
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Speaking at the SPLM state secretariat in Torit on Tuesday

key_facts.fact: SPLM州政治动员秘书称由Ezekiel Lol Gatkuoth领导的高级委员会已抵达东赤道州监督初选筹备
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: SPLM state secretary for political mobilisation Ephone Emmanuel Lolimo said a high-level party committee led by Ezekiel Lol Gatkuoth had arrived in Eastern Equatoria to oversee preparations for the party’s primary elections.

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
洛邦是否最终参加即将举行的选举尚未确认
